# Vendored upstream

Repository: https://github.com/Manevolent/ts3j

Commit: `db57d60c989e399626aa16d921390f5033e6cdeb`

Original Maven POM version: `1.0.3`. The retained upstream POM is provenance only;
Gradle `build.gradle` defines the actual fixed dependency graph. Local artifact version
is `dev.blocktalk.vendor:ts3j:1.0.3-blocktalk.1`.

The original `LICENSE` and per-file MIT/GPL notices are retained. `PATCHES.diff`
contains every changed upstream main-source file, relative to this upstream commit.
Changed files carry BlockTalk modification notices. `SOURCE_SHA256SUMS` records the
vendored main sources. Original deterministic tests are preserved; the external DNS
test is separated from the unit suite, not represented as a passing offline test.

See ../../docs/DEPENDENCIES.md for patch rationale and validation.
